item.title: Yanagida Village Satoyama: Rural Life on the Noto Peninsula — Guide
item.description: Yanagida Village sits within the Noto Peninsula’s UNESCO-recognised satoyama farming landscape, its terraced rice fields, thatched farmhouses and small farming plots reflecting centuries of traditional land management practices that balance agriculture with the surrounding forest and coastal environment. The village offers visitors a genuinely slow-paced glimpse of rural Noto life, considerably quieter than the peninsula’s more visited towns, with scenery that shifts dramatically across the seasons, from bright green rice paddies in summer to golden terraces at harvest time.
